disease_label_per_paper: Prosthetic joint infection complicated by Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia and tricuspid valve infective endocarditis
presentation_summary: A 69-year-old woman with left total knee arthroplasty presented with wound dehiscence and purulent discharge from the left knee joint.
The left knee was erythematous, swollen, and tender; WBC was 16 x10^9/L, CRP 15 mg/dL, and ESR 50 mm/hr.
Knee radiograph showed pneumarthrosis and fluid collection concerning for prosthetic joint infection.
Blood cultures grew MSSA; CT showed cavitary lung lesions suspicious for septic emboli; echocardiography and transesophageal echocardiography confirmed tricuspid vegetation.
